Name: Maggs Technomancy Sebastian enemies to lovers dialogue and events
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!
Find more about my Sebastian mods on my website: [url=https://maggplays.com/maggs-immersive-sebastian/]maggplays.com/sebastian[/url]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764217843.png[/img]
This is a story-driven mod, this is NOT a normal dialogue and events expansion. This is a story paced by game progression through rebuilding the Community Center, NOT by heart level.

[b][size=4]Gameplay Requirements[/size][/b]
[b]Smirking Frog PSA:[/b] notice the above word "requirements", these items are NOT suggestions.
[list]
[*]REQUIRES a new save. This is not a suggestion. This mod will not work correctly on an existing save. The end.[/*]
[*]REQUIRES the Community Center route, switching to Joja will break the story and events won't trigger correctly. Seriously.[/*]
[/list]Note: Using cheats to complete the CC rooms faster than the end of year 1 will result in missed story content, but will not break the mod. Cheat at your own risk.

[b][size=4]Mod Mechanics[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Includes a journal guidebook thanks to the Parchment framework. Details below.[/*]
[*]The Smirking Frog Event Commission will send you letters when events are available. Count on them, they are VERY reliable. The Smirking Frogs also send you PSA messages to give you tips and guidance.[/*]
[*]Farmer has a voice, this is necessary to tell the story. Farmer does have dialogue choices, but all drive the same storyline.[/*]
[*]Sebastian has unique dialogue every day of the first year, a major part of the story is told through daily dialogue.[/*]
[*]Sebastian will reject the bouquet before the community center is finished and a specific event seen. Feel free to offer one for a snarky response.[/*]
[*]Adds Marlon from SVE as a full, friendable character if you don't have SVE installed. (no SVE events for Marlon are included)[/*]
[*]Pace yourself - to get the most out of the story, complete the CC as normal at the end of year 1 or mid year 2. Want to really get into the content and force yourself to slow down? Try a challenging bundle mod![/*]
[*]Poly Players - this mod is technically poly-compatible until marriage, however Seb will not date the player if they are dating or married to someone else since he is not polyamorous in this mod. If farmer dates others while dating Sebastian, asks him out while already dating/married, or cheats while married to him, a warning will pop up describing what will happen and how to avoid it. No surprises.[/*]
[*]Dating other characters during the first year - farmer can date others before dating Seb, however, watch your timing! Break up with other people immediately after finishing the Community Center. If you do not, Sebastian will not confess to farmer. NOTE: Currently, you cannot get the Cold Shoulder event with this mod.[/*]
[*]Sebastian gets a job, moves out of the basement, and goes to work. His schedule and home location reflect this. He continues to work after marriage three days a week. Go bother him at work, you know you want to![/*]
[*]Full marriage content included:
Daily good morning conversation, unique every day of the first year of marriage
Events for the first two children, this will be expanded when I finish the Sebastian Kids mod for Have More KidsSebastian keeps his job and talks about work[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Player's Journal[/size][/b]
After learning the Junimo language, Magnus sends farmer an old apprentice's journal he found. This is your guide through the mod events and includes hidden achievements for fun.
The first page includes the Table of Contents. Click the first section under the To Do List, New Friends, New Start to find the first entry. Under the description and event hint is a checkbox. Once the goal is completed, a little frog appears in the checkbox. If characters have followup dialogue for that event, their icons appear with a speech bubble. Go talk to them to get their comments. Some even hint at next events!
Sticker Collection: These are hidden achievements that earn a sticker for your collection. See how many you can find! They are earned through different activities that involve Sebastian. Some are achieved through normal event progression, and others are for completing specific tasks, like giving a certain gift. More will be added with updates!
[b]Check the journal Help page for an in-game guide.[/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218055.png[/img]
[b][size=4]Compatible[/size][/b]
SVE - fully compatible and integrated
DSV - portraits and sprites are compatible, alternate orientation selections might not be. I won't be editing for this since Sebastian is pretty much neutral in DSV.
East Scarp, RSV, Sunberry (other than Wren for story conflicts)
Tractor Mod - compatible, but immersion-breaking if used early in the story. You'll see in the dialogue, it's up to you if you care or not.
ValleyNPCs - toggle off Marlon in that mod

[size=4][b]Not Compatible[/b][/size]
Other Sebastian dialogue/event mods (Including those by MaggPlays) - NOT compatible. This mod will override most of the dialogue, but any additional events will break the story.
Any mod that changes Sebastian's schedule, Nocturnal Sebastian for example. If it is an option, toggle Sebastian off.
Any mod that changes core game mechanics, how the Community Center unlocks, or Sebastian's base character profile.
[list]
[*]Polyamory changes core game mechanics, not compatible. Uninstall this mod before you date/marry other NPCs. There are in-mod notifications and consequences.[/*]
[*]No mods that change the start date to anything other than Spring 1.[/*]
[*]No mods that add rooms to the Community Center or change the vanilla flags for completing rooms.[/*]
[/list]Not compatible with any mod that adds Marlon as a friendable character (other than SVE) or you will have duplicate Marlons. This mod includes a [b]full friendable version of Marlon based on SVE[/b] if you don't have that mod installed. I did not include Marlon's SVE events, so no changes are made to sewer access or unlocking areas not included in vanilla.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764217595.png[/img]
[b][size=3]Was AI used in the creation of this mod?[/size][/b]
[i]SIGH[/i]... NO. I wrote every single word and line of code with my evil tiefling-loving hands.

[b][size=3]Why is this mod marked Beta? Did you not test it?[/size][/b]
I tested it as much as my sanity allowed, but this mod uses a lot of BETAS triggers and I can't test every single possible scenario. Please comment if you run into any issues, I actively maintain my mods.

[b][size=3]Does farmer's dialogue have female/male variants?[/size][/b]
Farmer is written to work with either female or male base. Their dialogue is neutral. My own personality is neither strongly feminine nor masculine, so I'm usually able to easily pull this off. That said, if you see a line that you feel is overly gender-leaning, you can comment with the exact line text. I will read your comment. That's all I promise.

[b][size=3]Is this polyamory compatible?[/size][/b]
Answered above, but since I know you will ask again, the answer is partially.
How? What does that mean?
[list]
Start your required new save and play through this story as far as you want. When you're ready to sow your wild oats, uninstall this mod. If you do not and you're married to Seb, the Smirking Frog Legal Team will arrive and serve you divorce papers signed by Sebastian. If you quit your game without saving and uninstall this mod, your relationship with him will not change.[/list][list]
But WHYYYYYYYY? You ask. And I will tell you.[/list][list]
Technical answer: Polyamory changes the core game code and limits my ability to customize marriage content. That is why. I will not entirely change my mod to accommodate another mod.Creative answer: I do not write for poly. I write very immersive storylines for a single character. AKA, I do not want to and I do not get paid for this.[/list][b]Will you make your mod compatible with [i](random mod name) [/i]mod?[/b]
Small compatibility tweaks? I will investigate and let you know. Will I change entire immersive content sections? NO. I am crazy obsessed, but I am not insane.

[b][size=3]I gave Sebastian a bouquet at 8 hearts and he said no![/size][/b]
Did he confess to you in an event? No? Then wait for the event. This story requires you to play through the events. You will be informed in the game when things unlock, either in the journal or mail from the Smirking Frogs.

[b][size=3]Where is the event list?? OMG... I can't live without an event list![/size][/b]
Events are in the journal. They show up there when they are unlocked. You will also get a letter from the Smirking Frog just in case you don't want to use the journal. Don't worry, you will be fine!

[b]Translation: [/b]This mod includes an i18n file, so it is translation-friendly. You do not need to ask for permission to translate, just make sure to add this mod as a dependency so people can find the translation.
